Find Expressed Markers

Source: R/FindExpressedMarkers.R
FindExpressedMarkers.Rd

Find Expressed Markers

Usage

FindExpressedMarkers(
  object,
  ident.1 = NULL,
  ident.2 = NULL,
  cells.1 = NULL,
  cells.2 = NULL,
  features = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  min.expression = 0,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  base = 2,
  pseudocount.use = 1,
  mean.fxn = NULL,
  fc.name = NULL,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  min.diff.pct = -Inf,
  max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
  latent.vars = NULL,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.cells.group = 3,
  min.cells.feature = 3,
  norm.method = "LogNormalize",
  seed = 11,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

features

Features to plot: a character vector or a named list of assay gene names or numeric metadata columns.

assay

Assay to use. NULL uses the default assay.

layer

Assay layer to use.

min.expression

The min.expression used.

seed

Random seed.

verbose

Print progress messages.

...

Additional arguments passed to reduction methods.

See also

[RunDEtest]

Examples

data(pancreas_sub)
pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub)
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Start standard processing workflow...
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Checking a list of <Seurat>...
#> ! [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Data 1/1 of the `srt_list` is "unknown"
#> Warning: Data 1/1 of the `srt_list` is "unknown"
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Perform `NormalizeData()` with `normalization.method = 'LogNormalize'` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Perform `FindVariableFeatures()` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Use the separate HVF from `srt_list`
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Number of available HVF: 2000
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Finished check
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:13] Perform `ScaleData()`
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:14] Perform pca linear dimension reduction
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:14] Use stored estimated dimensions 1:23 for Standardpca
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:14] Perform `Seurat::FindClusters()` with `cluster_algorithm = 'louvain'` and `cluster_resolution = 0.6`
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:14] Reorder clusters...
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:14] Skip `log1p()` because `layer = data` is not "counts"
#> ℹ [2026-08-19 12:15:15] Perform umap nonlinear dimension reduction
#> ✔ [2026-08-19 12:15:21] Standard processing workflow completed
markers <- FindExpressedMarkers(
  pancreas_sub,
  cells.1 = SeuratObject::WhichCells(
    pancreas_sub,
    expression = Phase == "G2M"
  )
)
head(markers)
